title: Record of Incidents on MRT and LRT Trains Such As Sudden Acceleration and Closing of Doors without Warning
what_it_is: Record of Incidents on MRT and LRT Trains Such As Sudden Acceleration and Closing of Doors without Warning

sections.label: Commuters report train speed and door incidents
sections.summary: Commuters reported average yearly cases of irregular acceleration and train doors closing without warning on MRT and LRT trains.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Commuters reported an average of 20 cases of irregular and sudden acceleration per year on Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) trains and two cases per year on Light Rail Transit (LRT) trains.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The abrupt changes in speed stemmed from temporary speed restrictions due to ongoing track maintenance and renewal works.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Over the same period, commuters reported an average of 125 cases of train doors closing without warning per year for MRT trains, and less than one case per year for LRT trains.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The NSEWLs are the only lines where the train doors are closed manually by the train captain on board.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The new Communications-Based Train Control signalling system will address this by automating the announcement and closing of train doors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Reports by commuters are the primary means by which data on such occurrences is collated.

sections.label: Signalling project and train renewal plans
sections.summary: The signalling project will improve train reliability, and about 66 old NSEWL trains will be renewed in coming years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: In time, we will consider publishing such data as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The signalling project will bring better reliability to our train systems.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We are also renewing the old trains on the NSEWL to the tune of about 66 trains in the coming years.
